checks.local_time: full geographic timezone boundaries and historical DST verified
checks.sunlight: flight timestamps drive Cesium sun, terrain and atmosphere; fade adjusted at flight height

environment.units: temperature 2m °C; precipitation preceding hour mm; wind 10m m/s stored as east/north vectors
environment.coverage: Every recorded fix and five interior fractions (.1, .25, .5, .75, .9) of every interpolated segment validated for temperature and wind.
environment.hosting: static per-journey JSON, lazy loaded; no browser weather API calls

expanded_source_verification.comparison: Original event identifiers, UTC timestamps, rounded longitude/latitude, individual identifier and scientific name checked against downloaded source CSVs; no synthetic GPS fixes.

camera_stabilization.heading_window: Ten minutes to twelve hours total initially, based on GPS spacing; expands up to threefold when direction is weak, within one recorded segment.
camera_stabilization.stationary_or_circling: hold previous heading when no reliable displacement exists
camera_stabilization.recorded_fixes: unchanged; marker, route and readings use original/interpolated GPS positions

limitations: GPS heights retain their published datum; no geoid conversion is claimed, and viewing height can be raised above terrain.
One-second eagle raw file unavailable; omitted.
Custom-licensed osprey data omitted pending owner permission.
Satellite and terrain imagery may vary in date, resolution and coverage.
Sunlight model omits weather, artificial lighting and bird visual sensitivity; 24h preview holds position.

USGS crane altitude was not released; pelican, barnacle goose and Orinoco goose selections lack consistent usable height, so viewing height is illustrative. Sparse fixes show the broad route; instantaneous speed may be unavailable.
Environment layers are hourly surface reanalysis estimates sampled at 1°; wind at bird flight altitude, turbulence and fine-scale weather are not measured.
Camera stabilization intentionally follows broader travel direction and may offset the camera by up to 150 m; it does not alter the GPS data or measure bird gaze.
Black kite selections show the Strait of Gibraltar migration bottleneck; taiga bean goose selections show moult migration. Not every journey represents a complete continental migration.
publication: Published through GitHub Pages; future pushes to main test, build and deploy automatically.
